title: Rep. John McGuire Disclosed 2 Micron Purchases: Both Down About 23% Since
content:
Rep. John McGuire (VA-5) disclosed two purchases of Micron Technology (MU) stock on November 1, 2026, dated September 25 and October 1, each in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

DateTickerCompanyType / sizePrice at trade vs. Nov 2 (Bargo est.)
Sep 25MUMicron Technology, Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$1,082.28 vs. $833.59 (−22.98%)
Oct 1MUMicron Technology, Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$1,097.39 vs. $833.59 (−24.04%)

Transaction dates: Sep 25 and Oct 1, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 1, 2026 (31 to 37 days later). Member: Rep. John McGuire, VA-5 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • Two purchases: Micron Technology (MU), $1,001–$15,000 each, on September 25 and October 1.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Micron about 23.0% lower on November 2 than on September 25 and about 24.0% lower than on October 1.
  • Timing: the filing came 31 to 37 days after the trades, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
31 to 37 days after the trades, which were dated September 25 and October 1. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 2 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
